text.p: Polish insurance firm TUiR Warta SA has allotted shares to the five selected Polish investors who subscribed for 3,022,829 shares in a February offering of up to 2,596,139 shares, Warta said in a statement on Wednesday.
Warta said Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK) received 1,211,531 shares, Kredyt Bank 250,193 shares and Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy SA (BPH) 302,883 shares.
Warta shareholders Kulczyk Holding and Anna Wozniak received 728,649 shares and 102,883 shares respectively.
The shares were priced at 48 zlotys each.
On Tuesday Warta said PBK had subscribed for 1,514,414 shares, Kredyt Bank for 334,686 shares, BPH for 312,500 shares, Kulczyk Holding 746,229 shares and Anna Wozniak 115,000 shares.

Warta has said about 75 percent of proceeds from the issue would be used for the acquisition of shares of banks from the treasury while the rest would be used to develop its distribution network and infrastructure.
